questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very happy (synonym of joyful)?
explanation: Cheerful is the correct spelling - C-H-E-E-R-F-U-L. Cheerful means noticeably happy and optimistic - a synonym of joyful.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning sad (antonym of happy)?
explanation: Miserable is the correct spelling - M-I-S-E-R-A-B-L-E. Miserable means very unhappy - an antonym of happy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning smart (synonym of intelligent)?
explanation: Clever is the correct spelling - C-L-E-V-E-R. Clever means quick to understand - a synonym of intelligent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning foolish (antonym of clever)?
explanation: Stupid is the correct spelling - S-T-U-P-I-D. Stupid means lacking intelligence - an antonym of clever.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning generous (antonym of selfish)?
explanation: Charitable is the correct spelling - C-H-A-R-I-T-A-B-L-E. Charitable means generous in giving to those in need - an antonym of selfish.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning rude (antonym of polite)?
explanation: Insolent is the correct spelling - I-N-S-O-L-E-N-T. Insolent means rude and disrespectful - an antonym of polite.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning brave (synonym of courageous)?
explanation: Valiant is the correct spelling - V-A-L-I-A-N-T. Valiant means brave and determined - a synonym of courageous.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning scared (antonym of brave)?
explanation: Timid is the correct spelling - T-I-M-I-D. Timid means lacking courage or confidence - an antonym of brave.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning begin (synonym of start)?
explanation: Commence is the correct spelling - C-O-M-M-E-N-C-E. Commence means to begin - a synonym of start. It has double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning end (antonym of begin)?
explanation: Conclude is the correct spelling - C-O-N-C-L-U-D-E. Conclude means to bring to an end - an antonym of commence.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning very old (synonym of ancient)?
explanation: Antique is the correct spelling - A-N-T-I-Q-U-E. Antique means old and valuable - a synonym of ancient.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning new (antonym of ancient)?
explanation: Contemporary is the correct spelling - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-O-R-A-R-Y. Contemporary means modern, belonging to the present - an antonym of ancient.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning honest (synonym of sincere)?
explanation: Genuine is the correct spelling - G-E-N-U-I-N-E. Genuine means truly what something is said to be - a synonym of sincere.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning fake (antonym of genuine)?
explanation: Artificial is the correct spelling - A-R-T-I-F-I-C-I-A-L. Artificial means made by humans, not natural - an antonym of genuine.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning humble (antonym of arrogant)?
explanation: Modest is the correct spelling - M-O-D-E-S-T. Modest means not thinking too highly of oneself - an antonym of arrogant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning wealthy (synonym of rich)?
explanation: Prosperous is the correct spelling - P-R-O-S-P-E-R-O-U-S. Prosperous means successful and wealthy - a synonym of rich.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning poor (antonym of wealthy)?
explanation: Impoverished is the correct spelling - I-M-P-O-V-E-R-I-S-H-E-D. Impoverished means made poor - an antonym of wealthy.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'The word _____ is a synonym for strict, meaning very firm.'
explanation: Stringent is the correct spelling - S-T-R-I-N-G-E-N-T. Stringent means strict or precise - a synonym for strict or severe.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning calm (antonym of stormy)?
explanation: Tranquil is the correct spelling - T-R-A-N-Q-U-I-L. Tranquil means free from disturbance, calm - an antonym of stormy or chaotic.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning spread (antonym of gather)?
explanation: Scatter is the correct spelling - S-C-A-T-T-E-R. Scatter means to throw in various directions - an antonym of gather. It has double T.

questionText: One of these synonym or antonym words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Prosparous is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is prosperous - P-R-O-S-P-E-R-O-U-S. Genuine, artificial, and tranquil are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning kind (synonym of benevolent)?
explanation: Magnanimous is the correct spelling - M-A-G-N-A-N-I-M-O-U-S. Magnanimous means very generous and forgiving - a synonym of kind or benevolent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning petty (antonym of magnanimous)?
explanation: Malevolent is the correct spelling - M-A-L-E-V-O-L-E-N-T. Malevolent means wishing evil to others - an antonym of benevolent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning eternal (antonym of temporary)?
explanation: Permanent is the correct spelling - P-E-R-M-A-N-E-N-T. Permanent means lasting or intended to last indefinitely - an antonym of temporary.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning hopeful (antonym of pessimistic)?
explanation: Optimistic is the correct spelling - O-P-T-I-M-I-S-T-I-C. Optimistic means hopeful and confident about the future - an antonym of pessimistic.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning see-through (antonym of opaque)?
explanation: Transparent is the correct spelling - T-R-A-N-S-P-A-R-E-N-T. Transparent means able to be seen through - an antonym of opaque.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning stubborn (synonym of obstinate)?
explanation: Tenacious is the correct spelling - T-E-N-A-C-I-O-U-S. Tenacious means very determined - a synonym of stubborn or obstinate.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning sad and pitiable (synonym of pathetic)?
explanation: Wretched is the correct spelling - W-R-E-T-C-H-E-D. Wretched means in a very unhappy or pitiable state - a synonym of pathetic.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning outstanding (synonym of exceptional)?
explanation: Remarkable is the correct spelling - R-E-M-A-R-K-A-B-L-E. Remarkable means worthy of attention - a synonym of exceptional.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning uncaring (synonym of indifferent)?
explanation: Apathetic is the correct spelling - A-P-A-T-H-E-T-I-C. Apathetic means showing no interest or enthusiasm - a synonym of indifferent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning strong (antonym of fragile)?
explanation: Resilient is the correct spelling - R-E-S-I-L-I-E-N-T. Resilient means able to withstand or recover from difficulty - an antonym of fragile.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Optimistik is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is optimistic - O-P-T-I-M-I-S-T-I-C. Magnanimous, malevolent, and permanent are all correct.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Remarkeable is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is remarkable - R-E-M-A-R-K-A-B-L-E. Transparent, tenacious, and apathetic are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning easy (antonym of difficult)?
explanation: Effortless is the correct spelling - E-F-F-O-R-T-L-E-S-S. Effortless means done without effort - a synonym of easy. It has double F and ends with double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning sharp (antonym of dull)?
explanation: Vivid is the correct spelling - V-I-V-I-D. Vivid means producing powerful feelings - a synonym for sharp or bright, antonym of dull.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning thin (antonym of wide)?
explanation: Slender is the correct spelling - S-L-E-N-D-E-R. Slender means thin and narrow - an antonym of wide or broad.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning rewarding (antonym of punishing)?
explanation: Beneficial is the correct spelling - B-E-N-E-F-I-C-I-A-L. Beneficial means resulting in good - a synonym of rewarding.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning growing (antonym of decreasing)?
explanation: Increasing is the correct spelling - I-N-C-R-E-A-S-I-N-G. Increasing means becoming greater in amount - an antonym of decreasing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning rough (antonym of smooth)?
explanation: Coarse is the correct spelling - C-O-A-R-S-E. Coarse means rough in texture - an antonym of smooth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning deep (antonym of shallow)?
explanation: Profound is the correct spelling - P-R-O-F-O-U-N-D. Profound means very deep or intense - an antonym of shallow.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Benificial is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is beneficial - B-E-N-E-F-I-C-I-A-L. Effortless, vivid, and slender are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning bright (antonym of dark)?
explanation: Luminous is the correct spelling - L-U-M-I-N-O-U-S. Luminous means giving off light - a synonym of bright or radiant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning wise (synonym of astute)?
explanation: Sagacious is the correct spelling - S-A-G-A-C-I-O-U-S. Sagacious means having or showing keen mental discernment - a synonym of wise.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning hidden (antonym of obvious)?
explanation: Obscure is the correct spelling - O-B-S-C-U-R-E. Obscure means not clear or not well known - an antonym of obvious.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning plentiful (antonym of scarce)?
explanation: Abundant is the correct spelling - A-B-U-N-D-A-N-T. Abundant means existing in large quantities - an antonym of scarce.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning flexible (antonym of rigid)?
explanation: Pliable is the correct spelling - P-L-I-A-B-L-E. Pliable means easily bent, flexible - an antonym of rigid or stiff.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning exact (synonym of precise)?
explanation: Accurate is the correct spelling - A-C-C-U-R-A-T-E. Accurate means correct and precise - a synonym of exact. It has double C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning ancient (synonym of old)?
explanation: Archaic is the correct spelling - A-R-C-H-A-I-C. Archaic means very old or old-fashioned - a synonym of ancient.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Abbundant is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is abundant - A-B-U-N-D-A-N-T. Luminous, sagacious, and obscure are all correct.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Accurrate is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is accurate - A-C-C-U-R-A-T-E. Coarse, profound, and increasing are all correct.
